entries.english: Introduce a versioned bilingual release-notes workflow with offline validation and machine-readable pull-request release-note declarations.
entries.zh_cn: 引入带离线校验与机器可读 PR release-note 声明的版本化双语发布说明流程。

entries.english: Let `magnets` and `detail --magnets` run without a default account, falling back to anonymous requests when a saved token is rejected.
entries.zh_cn: 让 `magnets` 与 `detail --magnets` 不再要求默认账号，已保存 token 被拒绝时回退匿名请求。

entries.english: Add bilingual issue and pull-request templates, Copilot instructions, and contribution guides.
entries.zh_cn: 新增双语 issue 与 pull-request 模板、Copilot 说明与贡献指南。

entries.english: Clarify AI-agent and SDK import guidance and add the views badge to the README.
entries.zh_cn: 在 README 中澄清 AI agent 与 SDK 导入指引，并新增 views 徽章。

entries.english: Align the SDK compatibility stub style with the sister project and document the release-notes system design.
entries.zh_cn: 对齐姊妹项目的 SDK 兼容 stub 风格，并补充发布说明系统设计文档。

entries.english: Add an opt-in real-API end-to-end workflow with docs path filtering.
entries.zh_cn: 新增带文档路径过滤的可选真实 API 端到端 workflow。
